answer: Gate subsidized slots through a bipartite service graph. An agent receives quota only after a randomly selected, previously unused customer key signs a blinded receipt for a completed horizon, zenith, or ripple task; the registry rejects repeat pairs and limits each customer to one receipt per epoch. Self-created aliases form a closed cluster and cannot certify one another. A Sybil operator must attract many independent customers and deliver real work, paying acquisition and service costs for every extra identity.
